column3: “Body” generalizes the loins; “bewildered” renders being bent over.
“Shields” is plural where the Hebrew has one shield.
“Teams” is plural instead of a pair; “chariots” is also plural.
The active breaking of the images is rendered as their lying shattered.
“My people” and “crushed” resolve the images of my threshed one and son of my threshing floor.
Meeting with bread is made an instruction rather than a completed action.
“Archers” resolves the image of the numbered bows.
